page.notes: Several Greek and Hebrew readings are uncertain and marked [?] where they appear; the Hebrew at p. 33 l. 6 and the Greek at p. 88 l. 3 and p. 89 l. 7 are especially doubtful. The printed long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "est" appears as "est" in the source sense. The mark "s" in "astum" and "coastive" may be a printed "ct" ligature, which cannot be confirmed at this scan resolution. The decorative rules above and below the text are not transcribed.
